canonical_revision: Sega Model 2 arcade, configurable operator defaults

sequence_policy.reference_status: provisional continuity tuning pending authorized arcade capture validation

chapters.title: TRAGEDY
chapters.intro: December 18, 1998. Rogan and G arrive at Curien's estate after Sophie's emergency call.

nodes.dialogue: Help! They're everywhere!
The front entrance is still open!

civilian.dialogue: They followed me from the courtyard!

nodes.dialogue: We have to go beneath the bridge.

civilian.dialogue: The creatures drove me into the waterway!

nodes.dialogue: Choose quickly — the creatures are closing in.
Rogan! Over here!
The floor won't hold!

nodes.objective: STOP THE ATTACK BEFORE THE FLOOR GIVES WAY
nodes.dialogue: An attacker blocks the narrow passage. A direct hit could break the floor beneath you!
The floor held. Continue along the upper corridor.
The impact shattered the floor. Fight through the passage below.
A knife thrower attacks across the portrait corridor. Shoot the projectile before it reaches you!
The projectile was stopped. Stay on the gallery level.
The enemy hit collapsed the gallery. Push through the flooded floor below.
Sophie is just beyond this room!
Rogan... the creatures... Curien made them...
Chariot, Type 27. Aim for the opening in its armor.

chapters.title: REVENGE
chapters.intro: The agents push deeper into Curien's mansion, where every rescue and every shot changes the route.

nodes.dialogue: That plate may open another path.
The tunnel leads beneath the library.

civilian.dialogue: I hid in the tunnel when the alarms started!

nodes.dialogue: No time for the hatch — through the doors!

civilian.dialogue: Don't leave me behind the doors!

nodes.dialogue: Don't shoot! I'm human!
The upper switch is active.

civilian.dialogue: The bridge controls are over here!

nodes.dialogue: The bridge is blocked. Go down!

civilian.dialogue: I couldn't reach the upper bridge!

nodes.dialogue: Something is circling above us.

civilian.dialogue: The bats are blocking the roof!

nodes.dialogue: Hangedman is coming back!

civilian.dialogue: Please! Get me away from the ledge!

nodes.dialogue: First eliminate the bats, then fire during its charge.

chapters.title: TRUTH
chapters.intro: Below the mansion lies Curien's research complex — and the truth behind the experiments.

nodes.dialogue: The switch controls both elevators.
Left elevator — upper research wing.
Right elevator — maintenance level.

civilian.dialogue: I was servicing the lower lift!

nodes.dialogue: Behind me! Get it off me!
I'll open the security door!
The door is locked. Through the conduit!

nodes.objective: SHOOT ONE OF THE TWO STEEL DOORS
nodes.dialogue: Two independent steel doors lead to different heights. Shoot exactly one door to choose the route.
Upper door selected. Cross the elevated research gantry.
Lower door selected. Follow the service conduit beneath the gantry.
Curien! This ends now!

civilian.dialogue: Curien went toward the underground chamber!

nodes.dialogue: Its head is vulnerable only when exposed. Shoot the web projectiles.

chapters.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD
chapters.intro: At the heart of the complex, Curien prepares his masterpiece. The dead rise for one final assault.

nodes.dialogue: Chariot has been rebuilt. Break through the weakened armor.
Hangedman attacks again with a smaller formation.
A hidden room opens only for agents who saved every scientist.
All scientists saved. The emergency cache is yours.
This is Curien's last line of defense!
My masterpiece will cleanse this world. Magician — obey me!
Magician rejects Curien and strikes him down. Fire at the exposed red tissue and destroy every fireball.
